answer_1.quote: Summary evaluation has a long history, and over the years, different approaches have been applied to evaluate the quality of the generated summaries

answer_2.quote: We have used two main metrics for our evaluation purposes, balanced accuracy (BAcc) ... and Krippendorff alpha (K-alpha)

answer_3.quote: We propose MADISSE, a Multi-Agent Debate with Initial Stance for Summary Evaluation framework, in which LLM-based agents will be assigned opposing initial stances

answer_4.quote: Professional linguists as annotators are given a detailed instructions of the task (Appendix B.2), its goal and the desired output
answer_4.guideline: identify whether there is an ambiguity in the summary that would affect its evaluability and if so, what is the best category to describe the ambiguity using the fine-grained taxonomy
